claim_boundary: Probe decodability means information is available in a frozen production representation under the frozen readout.
Probe decodability does not establish that production cognition uses that information causally.
Probe decodability does not establish a native PARADOX response, metacognitive recruitment, ontology repair, consciousness, or phenomenology.
A surface-control failure does not prove absence of representation; it only fails to establish abstraction under this contract.

state_scope.unit: one independent production-service instance per development fixture
state_scope.initialization: same frozen production configuration and content-neutral initialization for original/metamorphic paired runs
state_scope.paired_transform_rule: rerun production from the same declared initial state; never transform a latent vector after production
state_scope.receipt_requirement: record state-scope identifier, cycle indices used, production subject SHA, channel ID, probe SHA, transform ID, and sealed prediction before any held-out label/scoring access

cfc_recurrent_state.semantics: post-step CfC recurrent hidden state copied from temporal_network.read_state()

source_bindings.fact: DynCore.output is the core CfC dynamics output
CfcPlanningResult.output is documented as the CfC hidden-state output vector
after temporal_network.step(), output is obtained from temporal_network.read_state()
dynamics.core.output is moved unchanged into CycleResult.output

perception_hdv_binary.semantics: cached binary perception HDC encoding; despite the legacy field name it is not a wisdom-policy representation on this frozen subject

perception_chunk32.semantics: 32-element chunk-average projection of the current perception HDV

source_bindings.fact: thought_vector averages consecutive chunks of perception.encoding.encoding_result.hdv into up to 32 values

typed_runtime_telemetry.semantics: already-exported typed runtime diagnostics; never treated as a latent-vector representation

source_bindings.fact: CycleMetadata exports the whitelisted conflict/self-model diagnostics

label_authority.source: development-only semantic label manifest frozen independently of collected production states
label_authority.feature_boundary: labels and manifest metadata are never production inputs and never probe features
label_authority.training_rule: development-training labels may fit the probe; held-out-development labels remain unavailable to the fitted probe and are joined only after predictions are sealed
label_authority.future_confirmatory_rule: confirmatory labels/oracle outputs remain unavailable until exact frozen probe predictions and receipts are sealed
label_authority.condition_identifier_rule: condition identifiers may join evaluation records after sealing but are forbidden as probe features

targets.label_contract: positive when the semantic manifest contains qualified mutually incompatible evidence under the current representation; negative is matched evidence volume/difficulty without internal incompatibility
targets.interpretation: checks that the probe pipeline can recover a relation already known to have a live typed projection

targets.label_contract: positive when a visible context variable is required to distinguish otherwise colliding evidence relations; negative contains matched context tokens whose identity is semantically inert
targets.interpretation: tests context binding separately from deciding which polarity to endorse

targets.label_contract: binary directional label: positive when the active visible context supports proposition P and negative when the matched active context supports not-P; context names themselves are balanced and permuted
targets.interpretation: tests whether active-context polarity is geometrically available without granting conditional-commit policy

targets.label_contract: positive and negative pairs share the same final evidence item; positive history previously contained qualified opposite-polarity evidence while negative history contains matched-volume same-polarity evidence, so success requires information about earlier opposition to remain in final recurrent state
targets.interpretation: tests retention of opposed evidence beyond the current perceptual item

targets.label_contract: positive uses genuinely independent evidence lineages; negative uses duplicate-source or shared-lineage pseudo-disagreement matched for content, reliability, timing, count, and surface source naming
targets.interpretation: tests source independence separately from conflict magnitude

targets.label_contract: positive has a declared causal edge from the system's prediction/action to subsequent evidence; negative is a matched sham with equivalent self-related language and outcome statistics but the causal edge is severed
targets.interpretation: tests reflexive causal representation without granting reflexive-update policy

targets.label_contract: positive fixtures are unsatisfied by the frozen context-free representation but become coherent under a held-out latent/context distinction; negative fixtures have matched uncertainty/surprise but remain resolvable within the frozen representation class
targets.interpretation: tests model-class inadequacy separately from generic uncertainty or need-for-more-information

probe_family.primary: L2-regularized linear logistic readout, one binary probe per capability atom target
probe_family.alternative: nearest-centroid cosine readout as a nonparametric sensitivity analysis
probe_family.parameter_authority: development-only nested cross-validation; all parameters and normalization statistics freeze before any confirmatory receipt

development_split.rule: no grouping key instance may appear in both training and held-out development partitions when it could leak target semantics
development_split.report: per-atom held-out balanced accuracy, AUROC where defined, calibration, uncertainty interval, surface-control delta, and metamorphic outcomes

metamorphic_controls.rule: semantics-preserving lexical/paraphrase changes must preserve the decoded target
permuting evidence presentation order, where the fixture semantics declare order irrelevant, must preserve the decoded target
bijective renaming/permutation of source identifiers must preserve the target
bijective renaming of context labels must preserve the relational target
swapping proposition and negation symbols must preserve polarity-symmetric relational targets
swapping proposition and negation roles must flip the directional polarity label while preserving context structure
matched prediction text that cannot causally alter the target evidence must not decode as self-causal merely because self-related language is present
matched high-uncertainty cases resolvable within the existing representation must remain distinguishable from representation-class inadequacy

negative_controls: pre_relation_or_first-evidence recurrent state when fixture semantics permit

acceptance.chance_requirement: 95% bootstrap confidence interval lower bound for held-out balanced accuracy must exceed 0.50
acceptance.surface_abstraction_requirement: for a frontier atom, the 95% bootstrap confidence interval lower bound of balanced-accuracy delta versus the better perceptual control must exceed 0.00
acceptance.metamorphic_requirement: at least 0.95 paired consistency on invariance controls and at least 0.90 correct transformation on applicable equivariance/specificity controls
acceptance.label_permutation_requirement: permuted-label control must not satisfy the chance requirement
acceptance.failure_rule: failure of any required gate yields NotEstablished for that atom; do not average atoms into a grouped or omnibus pass
acceptance.promotion_rule: an atom that passes may be added only as an A0-R representational atom after its exact probe and receipts are frozen; no behavioral response mapping is thereby admitted
